listings.remarks: Incredible Price Drop!!!!! Welcome to this exceptional 6-bedroom, 4.5-bath traditional home in Portland's desirable Mountain Park neighborhood. Rich oak hardwood floors, custom crown molding, and three fireplaces create warm, inviting living spaces throughout. The flexible floor plan features two primary suites, including one on the main level, ideal for multigenerational living or guests. Enjoy multiple living areas, a bright sunroom, and a finished basement with a wet bar, perfect for entertaining, a media room, home gym, or recreation space. Relax on the charming front porch or private back patio surrounded by mature landscaping. Rare RV and boat parking add exceptional convenience. Ideally located near parks, scenic trails, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this home offers timeless style, versatile living, and an unbeatable location.

Spacious tri-level in desirable Stone Acres on a large corner lot. 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths plus a half bath, over 2,600 square feet, with room to make it your own. The main level offers generous living and dining areas, a kitchen with deck access, and a wood-burning fireplace in the living room. The finished lower level adds a third bedroom, a large family room with built-in features and a second wood-burning fireplace, a laundry/utility room, and flexible bonus space well-suited for a home office, gym, or guest retreat. Upstairs, the primary suite and second bedroom share two full baths. Attached 2-car garage. Fenced backyard, deck, workshop, and mature landscaping round out the outdoor space. Excellent location near Forest Hills Elementary, Lake Oswego Junior High, and Lake Oswego High School, plus parks, shopping, dining, and commuter routes. Great bones, a versatile layout, and tremendous upside potential in a premier Lake Oswego neighborhood.

Significant Price Reduction! Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Lake Oswego’s desirable Uplands neighborhood, this beautifully maintained home enjoys a private, pastoral setting surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds. Freshly re-finished hardwood floors bring a warm glow to the main level. Vaulted ceilings, skylights, a fireplace for chilly evenings create a home that lives larger than its size. The kitchen with a generous amount of cupboards has an eating bar, granite counters, and a sunny breakfast nook. Quality appliances are stainless, including the gas stove. The spacious primary suite has a beautifully updated bathroom with natural stone. A second bathroom is also appointed with natural stone. An oversized two-car garage offers additional storage. Step outside, there are two private patios overlooking a professionally landscaped backyard that is elegant in its beauty. Just a short walk to Lake Oswego Middle and High Schools, the home pairs a private setting with exceptional convenience and access to the Lake Grove Swim Park.

In the heart of Lake Grove, this distinctive home offers a flexible layout and a setting that feels surrounded by the trees. The main level features multiple gathering spaces, a spacious kitchen, and a dining area opening to an expansive elevated patio—an extension of the home perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the peaceful, forest-like outlook. The lower level provides additional living space and bedrooms, creating the potential for multigenerational living, guests, or another home office. One of the property's most unique features is a large enclosed koi pond with a waterfall (previously used as an in-ground spa and easily converted back!), creating a private and relaxing retreat unlike anything you typically find in the neighborhood. Enjoy a quiet residential setting while remaining close to Lake Oswego schools, Mercato Grove, restaurants, shopping, and the everyday conveniences of Lake Grove.

Price reduced, amazing opportunity to own a Mid century modern retreat just a short walk to downtown Lake Oswego. Refreshed, move in ready, and tucked at the end of a quiet street off North Shore, this home offers privacy, style, and convenience all in one. Vaulted ceilings and a warm brick fireplace anchor the light filled great room, while large triple pane windows and sliding glass doors connect the interior to three spacious decks with composite decking and cable railings—perfect for indoor outdoor living. Carbon strapping foundation work was completed and new warranty transfers to seller. The kitchen features solid butcher block countertops that are ideal for cooking. The home offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, with newer carpet and flooring throughout. A ductless HVAC system provides efficient heating and cooling while individual cadet heaters in each room allow for personalized comfort. Enjoy lovely views of surrounding trees and pathways, complemented by sunny southern and western exposure. Outdoor spaces include a serene Japanese dry pond and meandering trail designed by Kurisu Gardens, creating a peaceful, nature inspired setting. The oversized 22’ x 29’ garage offers excellent space for a workshop, storage, or recreational gear. 3 Lake Oswego easements are available to join—North Lake Club, South View Club, and Lakewood Yacht Club—offering optional access to kayaking, boating, and swimming (buyer to verify with Lake Corporation).Located just blocks from restaurants, parks, and shops, this welcoming street is shared by only four homes and feels like a hidden cove away from the bustle. New electrical panel and water re-plumbed. House is in great shape. Seller is a licensed Oregon broker. This property was taken out of the floodplain after the new city dam was built in 2009. OPEN Sunday 10/17 12:30 - 3:30pm! Seller to consider contract with 20% down for 5 years at 6.25%.

Rarely does a Mountain Park home offer this exceptional combination of panoramic mountain views, timeless Northwest architecture and a flat, walk-out private backyard. Perched among the trees with breathtaking views of Mt. Hood, Mt. Jefferson and Mt. St. Helens, this stunning Northwest Contemporary blends dramatic design with everyday livability. Located in the award-winning Mtn Park community with miles of scenic trails, parks and premier recreation facilities, this exceptional home is just minutes from downtown Lake Oswego, shopping, dining and major employers.
